implementation_summary: Retained the reviewed deterministic self-contained Governance Skill build and corrected both bounded T020-R1 findings. The builder now packages an explicit allowlist of required Consumer Skill files, assets, and script instead of copying the complete source Skill subtree, excluding STATUS.md and equivalent source-product overlays. Artifact-only tests build from disposable source, delete that source, and successfully execute bootstrap, validate, state, event, skill, ecosystem, and archive in an unrelated repository while preserving identity and isolation evidence.

architecture.artifact_root: The output directory is the complete Skill boundary; an explicit nine-file Consumer Skill allowlist, generated core/, runtime/, identity schema, and artifact-identity.json all live below it. Source lifecycle/status overlays such as governance-skill/STATUS.md are outside the package boundary.
architecture.canonical_core: governance-core/*.md is copied only during builds into artifact core/; no hand-maintained duplicate Core exists under governance-skill/.
architecture.runtime_resolution: governance-skill/scripts/governance.py resolves runtime/agent_governance and core/ inside a built artifact first, then preserves T018/T019 source checkout resolution for source tests and development.
architecture.identity: Build metadata separates build schema, Skill version, protocol version, installed-footprint version, source commit, sorted per-file SHA-256/size inventory, payload digest, and identity digest. Skill and installed-footprint versions are explicit strict-SemVer build inputs because source has no authoritative values for them; protocol version comes from canonical GOVERNANCE.md.
architecture.determinism: Canonical sorted compact JSON plus sorted path inventory makes repeated builds byte-identical at the identity metadata level for identical inputs. Payload bytes are compared directly with canonical Core/runtime/asset/schema inputs in tests.
architecture.atomicity: Builds reject existing outputs, assemble in a temporary sibling directory, and rename only after complete identity generation; failures remove temporary output.
